subject: Discovery follow-up: proposed rotating demo cadence & next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex@xenotech.io>, engops@xenotech.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: proposed rotating demo cadence & next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the discovery this morning. Quick recap below and a concrete proposal for the technical deep dive / demo cadence so we can lock calendars across US / EU / APAC.

Recap (2 mins)
- Main goal: validate latency & cost profile for Xenotech's inference patterns (multi-tenant telemetry + batch embedding pipelines).
- Success criteria for pilot: sub-200ms tail latency on 8k context, integration with your S3 flow, observable token-level cost reporting.
- Stakeholders you named: Alex (product), EngOps (ops), Marta (security) — please confirm.

Proposed next step: 60‑min technical deep dive + live demo. Because your team spans multiple time zones, I propose a rotating slot model so the same set of internal Xenotech stakeholders can attend at least once every 3 weeks without burning anyone regularly at odd hours. Suggested rotation windows (pick one):

Option A — "US Morning / EU Afternoon / APAC Evening" (recommended to start)
- Slot 1: Mon 08:00 PT / 16:00 BST / 23:00 SGT
- Slot 2: Wed 08:00 PT / 16:00 BST / 23:00 SGT

Option B — "EU Friendly / APAC Midday / US Late Evening"
- Slot 1: Tue 17:00 PT / 01:00 BST (+1) / 09:00 SGT (+1)
- Slot 2: Thu 17:00 PT / 01:00 BST (+1) / 09:00 SGT (+1)

Option C — "APAC First / EU Morning / US Overnight" (for heavy APAC participation)
- Slot 1: Wed 23:00 PT / 07:00 BST / 15:00 SGT

Cadence options: weekly (recommended for first two sprints), biweekly, or fortnight-by-region (we rotate which region gets the weekday-friendly slot).

Ask from you by EOD Monday: preferred rotation option + preferred cadence + definitive attendee list for the deep dive.

Attachments: demo-cadence-playbook.pdf (sample agenda + runbook), xenotech-mvp.xlsx (notes I captured during the call).

If you want, I can create a 3-week rotating calendar series and share a single calendar link. Ben (cc) — can you draft the invite once Alex confirms?

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(sean@redwood.com)

From: Alex Brown <alex@xenotech.io>

On Fri, Jun 13, 2025 at 3:02 PM Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex — thanks again for the discovery this morning...

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clear options. Quick responses inline:

- Stakeholders: yes — Alex (me), EngOps (engops@xenotech.io). Please add Marta (marta@xenotech.io), she'll want to sit in for the first security segment.
- Rotation preference: Option B works best for our Product and EngOps leads; Option A edges too late for APAC.
- Cadence: weekly for the first 4 sessions so we can iterate quickly, then switch to biweekly.

Security ask: Marta flagged that we need your SOC 2 questionnaire and any data retention details before the deep dive. Can you either attach the soc2-request-form.pdf or point me to a secure folder?

Times that look good for the first demo (please propose exact UTC invites):
- Tue Jun 17, 2025 17:00 PT / Wed Jun 18 01:00 BST / Wed Jun 18 09:00 SGT
- Thu Jun 19, 2025 17:00 PT / Fri Jun 20 01:00 BST / Fri Jun 20 09:00 SGT

We prefer Tue 17:00 PT if you can make it.

Thanks — Alex
